description: rcf build base-suite records the RCF suite's result on the committed base head; rcf build bundle (--next, an explicit id, or an amend round) refuses with exit 4 unless --base-suite names a green record for the current HEAD, never consults verified, and has no override. rcf build bundle <fbs-id> --acs <ids> emits an amend-round bundle on a complete or verified spec listing only the touched criteria. rcf/define/backstop.json, rcf build backstop adopt and --allow-unverified retire.
rationale: Redesign backstop (:51-53) and change 5 (:91); Q-01 a and Q-04 a (10:40Z); D-07 and D-08 (audit section 5), F-15, F-17, F-30, F-31, F-35; register WA-10.
title: rcf build bundle refuses any Build while the RCF suite is not green on the base, and bundles amend rounds by touched criterion
